author: Ari Koslow
title: Daniel Duarte optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Mets optioned Daniel Duarte to Triple-A Syracuse.
impact: Duarte had been recalled last week. He'll likely continue to move up and down throughout the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tobias Myers recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Mets recalled Tobias Myers from Triple-A Syracuse.
impact: Myers is set for a spot start on Monday against the Reds.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Short claimed off waivers by Mets
desc: The Mets claimed Zack Short off waivers from the Tigers.
impact: Short was designated for assignment by Detroit. He will add infield depth for the Mets.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Verlander (hip) throws simulated game Monday
desc: Justin Verlander is throwing a simulated game on Monday at Daikin Park.
impact: Verlander could return from the injured list later this week if all goes well.

author: Ari Koslow
title: DJ Herz (elbow) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: DJ Herz told reporters he will begin a rehab assignment on Tuesday.
impact: Herz is roughly 15 months removed from Tommy John surgery. He will likely require a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Elly De La Cruz (hamstring) to head on rehab assignment this weekend
desc: Elly De La Cruz will go on a rehab assignment this weekend.
impact: De La Cruz underwent a follow-up MRI last week. He'll likely play in a handful of rehab games before he is activated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Doug Nikhazy designated for assignment
desc: The Cubs designated LHP Doug Nikhazy for assignment.
impact: Nikhazy was claimed off waivers from the White Sox at the end of April. He will head back to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Spence recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Royals recalled Mitch Spence from Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Spence is set for a spot start on Monday against the Nationals. Eli Morgan was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Strider (elbow) shut down for four weeks
desc: Spencer Strider will be shut down from throwing for four weeks.
impact: After the four weeks are up, Strider will be re-evaluated. If he is cleared, he'll then begin a throwing program.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Woodruff (shoulder) to make another rehab start Tuesday
desc: Brandon Woodruff is scheduled to make another rehab start on Tuesday.
impact: Woodruff had a chance to return to the majors this week, but he'll instead make at least one more rehab outing. He tossed 68 pitches in his first rehab start with Milwaukee's rookie-level Arizona Complex League affiliate last Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonathan Pintaro recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Mets recalled Jonathan Pintaro from Triple-A Syracuse.
impact: Pintaro has allowed one run in 6 2/3 innings with the Mets this season. He'll add a fresh arm with Christian Scott headed to the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Domingo Gonzalez sent outright to Triple-A
desc: The Mariners sent Domingo Gonzalez outright to Triple-A Tacoma.
impact: Gonzalez passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will remain in the Mariners organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Patrick Wisdom optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Mariners optioned Patrick Wisdom to Triple-A Tacoma.
impact: This is likely a move to open a spot for J.P. Crawford on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Estevez (shoulder) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Royals transferred Carlos Estevez to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the Royals 40-man roster. Estevez remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connor Seabold traded to Royals
desc: The Royals acquired RHP Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Denis Samudio and cash considerations.
impact: Seabold was designated for assignment by Toronto. He'll get a fresh start in Kansas City.
